transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net landline customer services, my name is Liam. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Liam, my name is Miriam Jenkins. I subscribe to your Caller Display feature on our landline, but for the past week every single incoming telephone call displays 'Incoming Call' or 'Number Withheld' on our Panasonic cordless phones, even when family members call from their mobile numbers!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Good afternoon Miriam. I can inspect your calling line identity presentation profile on the local exchange. Before we test your line features, could you confirm your full postal address and your account security PIN?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it is 14 Woodlands Crescent, Harrogate, HG2 7PN, security PIN 3891, landline number 01423 881204.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you Miriam, that confirms your account details. Have you noticed any crackling, buzzing, or static noise on the voice line when speaking on the phone?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The voice call audio is crystal clear; it is solely the caller display information that never appears on the handset screens.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Could I place you on hold for two minutes while I query the local exchange switch calling line identity profile?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, Miriam. The exchange line profile indicates that the Calling Line Identification Presentation feature flag was switched to passive mode during an automated line card migration.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Why would an automated migration turn off a feature we pay for every month?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: During regional digital exchange card migrations, supplementary telephony features occasionally default to inactive until re-provisioned.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you switch the Calling Line Identification feature back to active right now?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, I am submitting an immediate provisioning command to re-enable active FSK caller display signaling.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Does my Panasonic cordless telephone need any special settings configured for your network?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Standard UK cordless telephone equipment adheres to the British Telecom SIN 227 FSK caller identification specification.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Our Panasonic phone has always worked with S-Net until this week.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The re-provisioning signal takes approximately three minutes to cycle through the line card registers.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Will re-enabling this feature wipe any of my stored speed-dial numbers or directory contacts?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: No, directory contacts and stored speed-dial numbers are saved in local handset memory and remain unaffected.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is reassuring to know.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Obviously Caller Display equipment cannot decode incoming telephone numbers if the exchange switch flag is provisioned as passive.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Right, I understand the technical requirement now.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Miriam speaking, my seventy-nine-year-old sister is recovering from hip surgery at home, and she gets targeted by fraudulent telephone scammers five times a day! We specifically pay for Caller Display so she can screen calls before picking up the receiver! Because your service says 'Call Withheld' on every incoming call, she answered a rogue builder who frightened her to tears! This failure is putting an elderly woman in direct danger!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I completely understand how deeply alarming and dangerous that is for your sister, Miriam. Having an elderly family member harassed by scammers when Caller Display should protect her is unacceptable, and I will verify and restore the Calling Line Identity feature on her exchange line right now.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Liam, that is very comforting to hear.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The exchange switchboard confirms that the active FSK signaling profile is now fully enabled on 01423 881204.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can we test an incoming call right now to see if the caller number actually shows up on the screen?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, I will initiate an automated loopback test call from our central test gateway.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I have the Panasonic cordless handset right here in my hand.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Sending test call now... The line should ring in approximately ten seconds.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The phone is ringing... Liam! The screen says: '0800 012 3456 - S-Net Network Test'! It worked!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Excellent! The FSK caller identification packets are successfully synchronizing between the exchange and your handset.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Let me check with my mobile phone as well: dialing our landline from my mobile right now...

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The secondary line ring should decode your mobile number between the first and second ring bursts.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The phone is ringing again... Screen displays: 'Miriam Mobile - 07700 900381'! It even pulled the contact name from the handset phonebook!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That confirms full name and number presentation functionality across both fixed and mobile networks.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: My sister will be able to see exactly who is calling before picking up the receiver again.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have also applied a five-pound goodwill credit to your bill to cover the days Caller Display was inactive.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you, that is very fair and appreciated.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I will also lock a permanent flag on the exchange database preventing future migration overrides.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That will ensure the feature stays active permanently.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: All line parameters are documented under technical reference TEL-99214-M.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: TEL-99214-M, noted down.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Before I complete the feature activation, what was that Harrogate landline number again?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: As I told you at the start of our call, it is 01423 881204.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you Miriam, the profile update has been permanently committed to our exchange logs.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Everything is working perfectly now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there any other aspect of your landline service I can assist you with today, Miriam?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No Liam, you have resolved our problem completely.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net landline customer services, Miriam. Have a wonderful and peaceful day. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye Liam.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.
